subject: Clarifying audit rights & fee flow for CloudSail reseller Order Form
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@cloudsail.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Keegan <mkeegan@cloudsail.com>
Date: 2027-08-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Questions on reseller fee allocation & audit rights

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited about moving Redwood onto our marketplace. Our legal and procurement teams reviewed the draft Order Form and the partner paper and have two items they need clarified before we can sign:

1) Audit / verification rights: the partner paper currently gives CloudSail the right to audit records "reasonably related" to fees. Our legal team would like this narrowed to a defined purpose and a maximum of one audit per 12 months, with mutually agreed notice and confidentiality protections.

2) Fee flow and invoicing (pass-through): the Order Form references "marketplace fees are passed through to CloudSail" but doesn't specify invoicing mechanics. Procurement wants to confirm: will RedWood invoice CloudSail directly for the marketplace fee portion, or will the reseller invoice and remit to Redwood with supporting usage statements? If the former, we need PO-friendly invoice fields and a contact for AP.

I attached the Order Form we received (redline expected) and highlighted the clauses.

Can your team confirm proposed language and who should be on the thread from Redwood legal? We aim to get this finalized before the end of the month.

Thanks,

Priya Shah
Head of Partnerships, CloudSail
priya.shah@cloudsail.com
+1 415-555-0123

Attachments: CloudSail_OrderForm_v3_redline.docx (annotated)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@cloudsail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-21T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on reseller fee allocation & audit rights

Hi Priya — appreciate the clear ask and the annotated doc. Quick answers inline below and attaching a short summary for AP: reseller-pass-through-summary.pdf.

1) Audit rights: Redwood is happy to limit audits to one per 12 months for fee verification purposes only, with 30 days' prior written notice. We'll accept confidentiality protections and are OK with a narrow scope restricted to records that relate to marketplace fee calculations. We'll have legal draft language but this is our position.

2) Fee flow: Redwood prefers to invoice CloudSail directly for the marketplace fee portion when CloudSail is the marketplace operator. That avoids multiple invoicing hops and simplifies reconciliation for both sides. That said, if CloudSail requires the reseller to invoice and remit, we can accommodate with a short addendum — we would need reseller AP contact details and agreement on statement format.

Cc'ing Ben Carter (sales ops) to confirm invoicing operationally and to loop in legal for formal redlines.

Proposed next steps:
- Ben to confirm AP invoice fields and provide sample invoice.
- Redwood legal (Laura) to propose redline language for audit and pass-through clauses.
- Priya / Mark to confirm if CloudSail prefers direct invoicing or reseller-mediated invoicing.

I have availability Thu/Fri this week for a 30-min wrap-up.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com

Attachments: reseller-pass-through-summary.pdf (1 page summary for AP)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@cloudsail.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-21T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on reseller fee allocation & audit rights

Thanks Priya / Aditya — looping in Laura (legal) and Karthik (partnerships ops). I captured the two scenarios for invoicing:

A) Direct invoicing to CloudSail by Redwood: Redwood issues an invoice that includes a line-item for "marketplace fee"; CloudSail pays Redwood; reseller handles distribution to end customer separately.

B) Reseller invoices CloudSail and remits fee to Redwood: the reseller would include a supporting usage statement; Redwood would accept the remittance plus the usage CSV for reconciliation.

If CloudSail prefers A, Ben (me) will provide PO-friendly fields (PO number, remit-to address, AP contact, tax id). If B, we need a contact at the reseller and a sample remittance file.

Also attaching the DocuSign draft link for the Order Form so legal can triage: CloudSail_Docusign_OrderForm_link.txt

Ben Carter
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Attachments: CloudSail_Docusign_OrderForm_link.txt

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@cloudsail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-22T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on reseller fee allocation & audit rights

Hi all — thanks for the summary. I reviewed the CloudSail redline and propose the following concrete language changes (high-level):

1) Audit clause (current): "CloudSail may audit Supplier records reasonably related to fees."
Proposed: "For purposes of verifying amounts payable under this Order Form, CloudSail may, no more than once in any 12-month period, upon at least thirty (30) days' prior written notice and during Redwood's regular business hours, inspect and review Redwood's relevant accounting records solely to the extent necessary to verify fees invoiced. Any such audit shall be conducted in a manner designed to minimize disruption to Redwood's business, shall be subject to appropriate confidentiality protections (including NDA protections), and shall be limited to documents covering the six (6) month period immediately preceding the audit request. Redwood may redact unrelated confidential information prior to disclosure."

2) Pass-through / invoicing (current): "Marketplace fees will be passed through to CloudSail."
Proposed: "If CloudSail is the marketplace operator, Redwood shall issue invoices directly to CloudSail for marketplace fees and shall include PO number, billing address, Redwood tax ID, and a supporting usage statement in CSV format. If CloudSail requests reseller-mediated invoicing, the reseller shall provide a single remittance per billing period accompanied by a usage CSV; Redwood's acceptance of reseller-mediated remittance shall be conditioned on the reseller providing a reconciliation workbook in a mutually agreed format. The parties shall document the selected invoicing approach in an addendum attached to this Order Form."

3) Limited audit evidence: Redwood requests that any audit findings that result in adjustments shall be resolved through a single conciliatory review and, except for instances of fraud or willful misconduct, neither party shall be entitled to seek penalties beyond the adjustment of fees going forward.

I attached a marked copy: CloudSail_OrderForm_v3_redline.docx (I added tracked changes). If everyone is OK with the above, I can prepare a clean redline for signature and Ben can push the DocuSign envelope.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Attachments: CloudSail_OrderForm_v3_redline.docx (tracked changes)

From: Mark Keegan <mkeegan@cloudsail.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@cloudsail.com>
Date: 2027-08-23T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on reseller fee allocation & audit rights

Laura / Aditya / Ben — thanks for the quick turnaround and the clear language. CloudSail is comfortable with the one-audit-per-12-months limitation and the 30-day notice; the limitation to a six-month lookback is acceptable.

On invoicing, CloudSail prefers scenario A (direct invoicing to CloudSail by Redwood) to keep AP simple. Please proceed with the clean redline and resend via DocuSign. Our team will route the PO once we see the final.

Let's tentatively schedule a 20-min handoff on Wednesday 08/25 at 10:00 PT to confirm the DocuSign envelope and PO fields — Priya will own PO issuance.

Best,
Mark Keegan
Director, Procurement, CloudSail
